Here's what was implemented, following the exact patterns from `page.tsx`:

**`app/Dashboard.tsx`**
- **`getDashboardData()`** — mirrors `getParallelData()` from `page.tsx`:
  - `Promise.all()` fires all three fetches concurrently (efficient, not sequential)
  - Native `fetch().then(r => r.json())` — same chaining style as the existing code
  - `try/catch` with fallback mock data so builds don't fail if APIs are unavailable
- **`Dashboard`** — remains an `async` Server Component, awaits the data, renders three sections

**Base URL**: Server Components can't use relative URLs with `fetch()`, so `process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` is used with a `http://localhost:3000` fallback. Set `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` to your deployed URL in production (e.g. `https://your-app.vercel.app`).
